headline: Constant-f rotating shallow-water flow has an exact lattice-mode projector atlas, finite-support periodicity criterion, and sharp unitary noncompactness boundary.
nonclaims: no target prime/zero law, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, functional equation, or Hilbert-Polya operator

no target compactness or trace-class promotion beyond the stated source-local noncompact/non-Schatten theorem

route_a.strongest_failure: The lattice is a spatial Fourier index, not an arithmetic primitive-orbit owner, and no target determinant is present.
route_a.strongest_positive: A source-native skew-Hermitian Fourier PDE admits a complete same-clock projector and shell atlas.

theorem.branches: zero geostrophic/PV branch and plus/minus inertia-gravity branches
theorem.degenerate_faces: n=0 has 0, plus/minus i|f| when f != 0; f=0,c=0 gives the full zero block
theorem.operator_boundary: global group is unitary and, for every t including t=0, is neither compact nor Schatten
theorem.periodicity: finite Fourier support is T-periodic iff omega_n*T is in 2*pi*Z for every participating nonzero branch
theorem.pv_invariant: for c>0, qhat_n=(-i n_y, i n_x, -f/c) dot (u1hat,u2hat,phihat) is stationary
